children: Scholastic reported results for the fiscal first quarter ended August 31, 2026, with revenue of $216.8 million and an operating loss of $92.2 million; adjusted EBITDA was a loss of $63.6 million. The company affirmed full-year fiscal 2027 guidance for revenue growth of approximately 2%–4% and Adjusted EBITDA of $135M–$145M, and expects Free Cash Flow of $35M–$40M. Management cited seasonally small Q1 activity, the full-period impact of prior sale-leaseback transactions and continued investments to support growth priorities.
Revenue: $216.8 million for the quarter, down 4% from $225.6 million a year earlier.
Operating income (loss): $(92.2) million as reported for the quarter.
Adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP): $(63.6) million for the quarter, versus $(55.7) million in the prior-year period.
Net income (loss): $(71.2) million for the quarter; diluted loss per share: $(3.77).
Adjusted diluted loss per share (non-GAAP): $(3.63) for the quarter (excludes one-time items).

Children’s Books: Book Fair bookings are ahead of prior year entering Q2; Book Fairs revenue was $33.2 million and Book Clubs revenue increased to $2.1 million. Consolidated Trade revenue declined due to fewer international co-edition sales versus the prior year.

Education: Revenue declined amid continued pressure on school and district budgets; the segment is progressing on cost-structure alignment and transformation initiatives to support long-term performance.
Entertainment: Production activity and pipeline expanded with higher production revenues, driving segment revenue to $20.1 million and an improved adjusted operating loss versus the prior year.
International: Revenue increased modestly to $60.5 million (including favorable FX), with improvements from cost management and operational efficiencies reducing adjusted operating loss.

Corporate actions and capital allocation: Company completed sale-leaseback transactions (impacting rental income and rent expense), returned about $29.6 million to shareholders in the quarter via buybacks and dividends, and had $157.4 million remaining under the repurchase authorization.

title: Scholastic reports Q1 FY2027: Revenue $216.8M, operating loss $92.2M, affirms FY2027 guidance
